name: Dodge
text: When an enemy attack misses this model, it may advance up to 2 inches once the attack is resolved.

name: Grappling Hook
text: At the end of its activation this model may pay 1 focus to be placed anywhere completely within 5 inches of where it stands.

name: Vital Magic
text: When an effect would end one of this model's upkeep spells, it may keep that spell by taking d3 damage for each one kept.

name: Wraithbinder
text: Friendly Incorporeal models within 10 inches of this model have +3 ARM.

name: Aggressive
text: This model runs and charges without paying focus.

name: Soul Taker: Collector
text: This model can hold up to 3 soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed within 10 inches, the nearest friendly Soul Taker with room takes one soul token.

name: Shadow Gate
text: Once per turn, after this model hits an enemy with a melee attack during its activation, it may spend one soul or corpse token to be placed completely within 2 inches of where it stands.

name: Soul Generator
text: At the start of its activation this model may spend soul tokens to gain 1 focus each, up to its focus limit.

name: Soul Phase
text: During its activation this model may spend one soul token to become Incorporeal for the turn.
verify: Any-time self ability: offered before the move, at the Combat Action choice and between attacks (not only at activation start); core refuses it while the model is already Incorporeal.

name: Ancillary Attack
text: Special action, range 3: a friendly Cryx warjack in range immediately makes one basic melee or ranged attack. Each model can be given this only once per turn.

name: Enliven
text: Special action, range 3: for a round, the next time the chosen friendly Cryx cohort model is damaged by an enemy attack it may make a full advance after that attack resolves, then Enliven ends.

name: Repair [d3+3]
text: Special action, range 1: remove d3+3 damage points from a friendly Cryx construct.

name: Exhaust Fumes
text: When this model advances in its Normal Movement, other friendly models within 3 inches of it gain concealment for a round.

name: Incorporeal
text: Ghostly: this model is not an intervening model, ignores obstructions, terrain and models when moving, and takes no damage from non-magical sources or continuous effects. It cannot be pushed, slammed or thrown. It loses this rule until its next activation when it makes a melee or ranged attack.

name: Magic Ability
text: Special attacks and actions of this model count as casting a spell.

name: Marionette
text: Arcane special attack, range 10, no damage. For a round, the Furies player may force one affected enemy model to reroll one of its own attack or damage rolls, after which Marionette ends. Only one model in the unit may use it per activation.

name: Power of Death
text: Special action: for a turn, friendly undead models within 10 inches of this model add 2 to their melee damage rolls. Only one model in the unit may use it per activation.

name: Stygian Abyss
text: Arcane special attack, range 10, POW 12. A critical hit blinds the target for a round. Only one model in the unit may use it per activation.

name: Mortal Fear
text: Living enemy models within 8 inches of this model take -2 on their damage rolls. Copies of the same effect do not stack.

name: Apparition
text: In your Control Phase this model may be placed completely within 2 inches of where it stands.

name: Wraith Shot
text: This model may spend a soul token on a Soul Cannon attack: the shot needs no line of sight and ignores cover and concealment, and its attack and damage rolls are boosted for free.

name: Wraith Shot (damage)
text: The damage roll of a shot made with Wraith Shot gains one extra die.

name: Shadow Fire
text: A model hit by this attack does not block line of sight for a turn.

name: Devour Soul
text: When this weapon destroys a living enemy model, its soul goes to a friendly Soul Taker chosen by its owner, anywhere on the table. Enemies never gain these souls.

name: Critical Corrosion
text: A critical hit with this weapon makes the target suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.

name: Volume Fire
text: Attack rolls with this weapon get +1 against 40 mm bases and +2 against bases of 50 mm or more.

name: Volume Fire (large)
text: Attack rolls with this weapon get +2 against bases of 50 mm or more.

name: Volume Fire (damage)
text: Damage rolls with this weapon get +1 against 40 mm bases.

name: Volume Fire (damage, large)
text: Damage rolls with this weapon get +2 against bases of 50 mm or more.

name: Banish
text: After this weapon damages a non-Leader enemy, that model is moved anywhere completely within 1 inch of where it stood.

name: Blood Shadow
text: When this weapon boxes a living or undead model, its bearer may become Incorporeal for a round.

name: Blessed
text: Attacks with this weapon ignore the ARM and DEF bonuses given by spells and animi.

name: Critical Knockdown
text: A critical hit with this weapon also knocks the target down before damage is rolled.

name: Cavalry
text: The attack roll of this model's charge attack is boosted, with no focus spent.

name: Finisher
text: Roll one extra die on this model's damage rolls against a model that already has damage marked.

name: Anatomical Precision
text: When this model's melee damage roll does not beat the ARM of a living model, that model still takes 1 damage. A model this model's melee attack disables gets no Tough roll.

name: Grim Returns
text: Special action, range 5: choose a friendly Grunt in range (not a character). One destroyed Grunt of its unit comes back with one box unmarked, placed within 2 inches of the chosen trooper. It gives up its Normal Movement and Combat Action this turn.
verify: The no-op advance node only tells core to offer a chosen friendly target (needsTarget in phases/activation.ts); the code hook does the work.

name: Empower
text: Special action, range 6: a friendly Cryx warjack in range loses Disruption and gains 1 focus. Only one model in the unit may use it per activation.
verify: As Grim Returns: the no-op advance node marks a targeted action.

name: Necrosurgery [d3+1]
text: Special action, range 1: remove d3+1 damage points from a friendly undead Cryx model.

name: Eyeless Sight
text: This model sees through clouds and ignores concealment and Stealth when picking targets.

name: Arc Node
text: This warjack can carry its warcaster's spells: the caster may channel a spell through it.
verify: Spell channelling (spells.ts channelers) looks for the ability core.a.arc-node, which core/abilities.json does not define yet, so this model carries the flag arcNode instead. When core adds core.a.arc-node, put it in cry.raptor-arc abilities and drop this record.
